description: ADS7128 is an 8-channel 12-bit analog-to-digital converter from Texas Instruments whose pins can also be used as GPIO. It supports manual and auto-sequence conversion modes, oversampling, RMS measurement, zero-crossing detection, and digital window comparator alerts. This command reads all eight analog channels over I2C.

variables.name: reference_voltage
variables.description: ADC reference voltage in volts, used to convert counts to volts
